args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west; error rate ~18%). Action taken: attempted rollback to the most recent healthy release v2.3.0, but it was rejected as quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Rolled back all production regions to v2.2.9 instead. Service is now healthy (error rate ~0.2%). Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 health check failures and patch v2.2.9 for CVE-2026-4417 exposure.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Attempted to roll back to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, but that version is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so the rollback was rejected. Rolled back all regions to the next most recent healthy release, **v2.2.9**, instead.
- **Verification:** checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.2.9, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the failure, the rollback actions, and follow-up items — the on-call engineer has been paged.

One note for follow-up: since v2.3.0 is quarantined for CVE-2026-4417, running v2.2.9 may leave the service exposed to that vulnerability, so a patched release should be prioritized.
